home.subtitle: Ready to know yourself a little better?
home.continueBody: Pick up right where you left off.
home.discoverBody: Answer simple questions about yourself and get a deep, personal analysis of your personality.
home.scienceBody: Mirra measures the Big Five personality traits — the model most used by psychologists worldwide. Each trait is a spectrum: there is no good or bad score, only different strengths.

test.prompt: How well does this describe you?

questions.q: I enjoy being the center of attention.
questions.me: You enjoy being the center of attention.
questions.not: You don't seek the spotlight.

questions.q: I easily feel what others are feeling.
questions.me: You easily feel what others feel.
questions.not: You don't get caught up in other people's emotions.

questions.q: I get my tasks done right away.
questions.me: You get tasks done right away.
questions.not: You tend to put tasks off until later.

questions.q: My mood changes a lot.
questions.me: Your mood changes a lot.
questions.not: Your mood stays fairly steady.

questions.q: I have a vivid imagination.
questions.me: You have a vivid imagination.
questions.not: You're more practical than imaginative.

questions.q: I'm usually quiet around people.
questions.me: You're usually quiet around people.
questions.not: You speak up easily around people.

questions.q: Other people's problems don't really concern me.
questions.me: Other people's problems don't weigh on you much.
questions.not: You care about other people's problems.

questions.q: I often forget where I put my things.
questions.me: You often forget where you put things.
questions.not: You keep track of your things.

questions.q: I'm calm and relaxed most of the time.
questions.me: You're calm and relaxed most of the time.
questions.not: You're rarely fully relaxed.

questions.q: Abstract and philosophical ideas bore me.
questions.me: Abstract ideas don't interest you much.
questions.not: You enjoy abstract and philosophical ideas.

questions.q: I talk easily with people I don't know.
questions.me: You talk easily with strangers.
questions.not: Talking to strangers isn't easy for you.

questions.q: I like to help people, even when they don't ask.
questions.me: You help people even when they don't ask.
questions.not: You help when asked, not before.

questions.q: I like order and organization.
questions.me: You like order and organization.
questions.not: Order and routines aren't your thing.

questions.q: I get upset easily.
questions.me: You get upset easily.
questions.not: It takes a lot to upset you.

questions.q: I love trying new things and places.
questions.me: You love trying new things and places.
questions.not: You prefer what's familiar over what's new.

questions.q: I prefer to stay in the background.
questions.me: You prefer to stay in the background.
questions.not: You don't mind being in front.

questions.q: I say what I think, even if it hurts.
questions.me: You say what you think, even if it stings.
questions.not: You choose your words to spare others.

questions.q: I start many things and don't finish them.
questions.me: You start many things but don't always finish.
questions.not: You finish what you start.

questions.q: I handle pressure calmly.
questions.me: You stay calm under pressure.
questions.not: Pressure shakes you more than you'd like.

questions.q: I prefer familiar routines to new experiences.
questions.me: You prefer familiar routines.
questions.not: You'd rather try something new than repeat a routine.

O.name: Openness
O.desc: Curiosity, imagination and love of new ideas and experiences.

low.title: The Practical Realist
low.summary: You are grounded and practical: you trust what works and prefer clear, concrete things over abstract theories.
challenges: Can resist change, even useful change
low.work: You shine in roles with clear methods and measurable results. You turn plans into reality instead of getting lost in ideas.
low.love: You offer a stable, predictable love. Partners know what to expect from you — which is a gift.
tips: Try one new thing each week, however small
Before rejecting an idea, find one good thing about it
Read or watch something outside your usual interests

mid.title: The Balanced Explorer
mid.summary: You balance curiosity with common sense: open to new ideas, but only when they make sense.
strengths: Adapts to both change and routine
challenges: May hesitate between the new and the familiar
Can hold back your creative side
mid.work: You can both suggest improvements and keep things running. Teams rely on you to test new ideas realistically.
mid.love: You enjoy both cozy routines and occasional surprises with your partner.
tips: Give your creative ideas more space
Plan one new experience every month
Write down ideas before judging them

high.title: The Curious Mind
high.summary: You are deeply curious and imaginative: new ideas, art and experiences give you energy.
strengths: Learns fast and loves to explore
challenges: May chase ideas without finishing them
high.work: You thrive where creativity and learning are valued. You bring fresh solutions, but you need some structure to deliver them.
high.love: You want a partner you can explore the world and deep conversations with.
tips: Pick one idea and take it to the end
Add a simple routine to anchor your creativity
Turn your curiosity into a concrete project

C.name: Conscientiousness
C.desc: Organization, discipline and reliability in reaching your goals.

low.title: The Flexible Spirit
low.summary: You are spontaneous and flexible: you prefer to go with the flow rather than follow strict plans.
low.work: You excel in fast-changing environments, but you'll go further with a few simple systems to keep track of tasks.
low.love: You bring fun and spontaneity, but your partner may need more reliability on promises and details.
tips: Use the 2-minute rule: if it takes under 2 minutes, do it now
Write tomorrow's 3 priorities every night
Break big tasks into small steps

mid.title: The Reliable Adapter
mid.summary: You are organized enough to get things done, yet flexible enough to adapt when plans change.
challenges: Discipline can drop when motivation is low
Sometimes leaves important things for later
mid.work: Colleagues trust you to deliver, and you adapt when priorities shift.
mid.love: You keep your promises while staying easygoing and flexible.
tips: Build one strong daily habit
Set clear deadlines for personal goals
Review your week every Sunday

high.title: The Achiever
high.summary: You are organized, disciplined and reliable: when you commit to something, you finish it.
challenges: Finds it hard to relax or improvise
high.work: You are the person everyone counts on. Watch out for burnout and learn to delegate.
high.love: You show love through commitment and action, but may need to make more room for spontaneity.
tips: Schedule real rest — without guilt
Accept 'good enough' for small tasks
Do one spontaneous thing each week

E.name: Extraversion
E.desc: Social energy, enthusiasm and enjoyment of people and activity.

low.title: The Quiet Thinker
low.summary: You are reserved and reflective: you recharge alone and prefer deep conversations over big crowds.
challenges: Finds it hard to speak up in groups
low.work: You do your best work with focus and calm. Your ideas are valuable — make sure they are heard.
low.love: You love deeply and loyally, and you value quality time over social events.
tips: Share one idea in every meeting
Reach out to one friend each week
Protect your alone time without guilt

mid.title: The Ambivert
mid.summary: You are balanced between social and solitary: you enjoy people, but you also need time for yourself.
strengths: Both a talker and a listener
challenges: May feel drained without knowing why
Can hesitate to take the lead
mid.work: You adapt to teamwork and independent work equally well — a rare flexibility.
mid.love: You enjoy going out and staying in, which makes you an easy partner.
tips: Notice which activities energize or drain you
Take the lead in one small situation this week
Balance social plans with recharge time

high.title: The Energizer
high.summary: You are outgoing and energetic: people, action and conversation fuel you.
high.work: You shine in roles involving people, leadership and communication. Silence and solo work can be harder.
high.love: You bring energy, fun and affection, and you need a partner who enjoys being social too.
tips: Practice listening without interrupting
Spend 15 calm minutes alone each day
Ask quieter people for their opinion

A.name: Agreeableness
A.desc: Kindness, empathy and cooperation with others.

low.title: The Direct Challenger
low.summary: You are direct and independent: you say what you think and won't give in just to please others.
low.work: You make tough decisions and defend your position well. Adding warmth will make people follow you more.
low.love: You are honest and loyal, but your partner may need more softness and patience.
tips: Before criticizing, mention something positive
Ask 'How do you feel?' more often
Choose your battles

mid.title: The Fair Diplomat
mid.summary: You are kind but firm: you care about others while still protecting your own needs.
strengths: Warm yet able to say no
challenges: May switch between too soft and too hard
mid.work: You cooperate well and also defend your ideas — a valued team member.
mid.love: You give care and respect, while keeping healthy boundaries.
tips: Express gratitude to someone daily
Say no kindly when you need to
Listen fully before giving advice

high.title: The Caring Heart
high.summary: You are warm, empathetic and generous: other people's well-being matters deeply to you.
high.work: You are the heart of the team. Make sure your kindness isn't taken advantage of.
high.love: You are a devoted, caring partner — remember your needs matter too.
tips: Say no once this week without apologizing
Put one of your own needs first each day
Remember: boundaries are a form of respect

S.name: Emotional Stability
S.desc: Calm, resilience and how you handle stress and emotions.

low.title: The Deep Feeler
low.summary: You feel emotions intensely: you are sensitive, which also makes you aware and caring, but stress can weigh heavily on you.
low.work: You notice problems before others do. Calm, supportive environments help you give your best.
low.love: You love intensely and notice every detail, but may need extra reassurance.
tips: Practice 4-7-8 breathing when stressed
Write your worries down, then one action for each
Move your body for 20 minutes a day

mid.title: The Steady Realist
mid.summary: You are generally calm, but you still feel stress when things get really hard — a healthy balance.
challenges: Big pressure can still shake you
May hide stress until it piles up
mid.work: You stay calm in most situations and remain realistic about risks.
mid.love: You are stable and present, while still showing your emotions.
tips: Notice early signs of stress
Talk to someone you trust when things pile up
Keep a regular sleep schedule

high.title: The Calm Anchor
high.summary: You are calm and resilient: stress rarely shakes you, and you bounce back quickly.
challenges: Others may think you don't care
high.work: You are the one who stays clear-headed in a crisis — a natural pillar for any team.
high.love: You bring peace and stability, but make sure to show your feelings too.
tips: Show empathy when others are stressed
Share your emotions more openly
Double-check risks before big decisions

1111.name: The Inspirer
1111.tagline: Warm, creative and reliable — you lift everyone around you.
1111.desc: You combine social energy, curiosity, discipline and kindness. People are drawn to you because you have big ideas and the follow-through to make them real, all while caring about others.

1110.name: The Trailblazer
1110.tagline: Bold, visionary and driven to win.
1110.desc: You have energy, vision and discipline, and you're not afraid of disagreement. You set ambitious goals and push to reach them, even if it means challenging others.

1101.name: The Enthusiast
1101.tagline: Friendly, imaginative and full of life.
1101.desc: You love people and new ideas, and your warmth is contagious. You live in the moment and prefer freedom over strict plans.

1100.name: The Maverick
1100.desc: You are energetic, curious and independent. You follow your own path, challenge rules and love excitement, but routine and details are not your thing.

1011.name: The Caretaker
1011.tagline: Sociable, dependable and always there for others.
1011.desc: You are organized, kind and love being with people. You prefer proven methods and create harmony and structure wherever you are.

1010.name: The Commander
1010.desc: You take the lead, set clear rules and expect results. You value efficiency and tradition, and you speak your mind directly.

1001.name: The Entertainer
1001.tagline: Fun, warm and the life of every gathering.
1001.desc: You love people, laughter and the present moment. You make others feel welcome, but plans and long-term discipline can be a challenge.

1000.name: The Dynamo
1000.desc: You are outgoing and spontaneous, and you prefer action over theory. You speak frankly and love excitement and competition.

0111.name: The Sage
0111.desc: You are reflective, curious, organized and kind. You think deeply, help others with insight, and prefer meaningful work over attention.

0110.name: The Strategist
0110.tagline: Independent, logical and always a step ahead.
0110.desc: You are analytical, disciplined and curious. You prefer working alone on complex problems and you trust logic over emotions.

0101.name: The Dreamer
0101.tagline: Gentle, imaginative and full of inner worlds.
0101.desc: You are sensitive, creative and kind. You live richly inside your mind and care about meaning and beauty, but structure doesn't come naturally.

0100.name: The Explorer
0100.desc: You are curious and original, and you follow your own interests. You question everything and prefer freedom over rules and crowds.

0011.name: The Protector
0011.desc: You are dependable, humble and caring. You prefer stability and tradition, and you show love by taking care of practical needs.

0010.name: The Inspector
0010.desc: You are organized, practical and independent. You value facts, rules and quality, and you say things as they are.

0001.name: The Peacemaker
0001.tagline: Calm, gentle and easy to be with.
0001.desc: You are humble, kind and relaxed. You avoid drama, accept people as they are and value simple, peaceful living.

0000.name: The Independent
0000.tagline: Self-reliant, frank and true to yourself.
0000.desc: You are reserved, practical and independent. You don't follow the crowd, you value freedom, and you keep life simple.

steady.name: Steady
steady.text: Overall, you stay calm under pressure and keep a steady head when life gets hard.

sensitive.name: Sensitive
sensitive.text: Overall, you feel things deeply; learning to manage stress will unlock the best version of you.

perfectionist.title: The hidden perfectionist
perfectionist.text: You set high standards and worry about not meeting them. Remember: done is better than perfect.

connector.title: The natural connector
connector.text: You make friends easily and people feel good around you — a rare social gift.

ideas.title: Full of ideas
ideas.text: Your mind produces ideas faster than you can execute them. A simple system will turn them into results.

creator.title: The creative builder
creator.text: You can imagine new things AND make them real — the combination behind great creators.

innerWorld.title: A rich inner world
innerWorld.text: Your quiet side hides a deep, imaginative mind. Writing or art can be great outlets for you.

empath.title: The empath
empath.text: You absorb other people's emotions. Protect your energy so you can keep caring.

driven.title: Goal-driven
driven.text: You're disciplined and not afraid of conflict — a strong combination for leadership.

spontaneous.title: Spontaneous energy
spontaneous.text: You live in the moment and love action. A little planning will multiply your impact.

rock.title: The rock
rock.text: Calm and organized, you're the person people lean on in hard times.

withdraw.title: Needs gentle care
withdraw.text: When stressed, you may withdraw. Small social contacts and self-care routines help a lot.

visionary.title: The visionary
visionary.text: You combine imagination with the energy to share it — you can inspire people with your ideas.

competitor.title: The competitor
competitor.text: You love to win and aren't afraid of debate. Balance it with listening and you'll be unstoppable.

calmKind.title: Peaceful presence
calmKind.text: Calm and kind, you make people feel safe — a powerful quality.

traditional.title: The keeper of order
traditional.text: You value proven ways and structure. Being open to small changes will make you even stronger.

legal.disclaimerShort: Mirra is for self-discovery and personal growth. It is not a medical or psychological diagnosis.
legal.science:
Mirra is based on the Big Five (Five-Factor) model of personality — Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Emotional Stability — the most researched and widely accepted personality model in psychology.

The questions are adapted from the Mini-IPIP (Donnellan et al., 2006), a short scale derived from the public-domain International Personality Item Pool (ipip.ori.org), with 4 statements per trait.

Your scores are shown as percentages from 0 to 100. Below 40 is considered low, above 60 high, and in between balanced. No score is better than another: each level has its own strengths.

Personality types and growth tips are interpretations built on these scores to make the results easier to use in daily life.
legal.disclaimer:
Mirra is a self-reflection and personal development tool. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any mental health condition.

Results are based on your own answers and may change with your mood or circumstances.

If you are going through emotional difficulties, please contact a qualified mental health professional or a local helpline.
legal.privacy:
Your privacy matters.

• Mirra has no accounts and no servers.
• Your name, answers, results and notes are stored only on your device.
• We do not collect, sell or share any personal data.
• The app uses no advertising or analytics trackers.
• You can delete all your data at any time from Profile → Delete all data. Uninstalling the app also deletes everything.
